title: Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms Using Python
description: This NPTEL course covers Python programming from basics through data structures and algorithm design. Topics include recursion, sorting, searching, and graph algorithms. Taught by faculty from IIT Madras.

title: Introduction to Machine Learning
description: Comprehensive NPTEL course covering supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms including regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction, and neural networks. Taught by faculty from IIT Kharagpur.

title: Deep Learning
description: NPTEL course on deep learning covering feedforward neural networks, convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, attention mechanisms, and generative models. Taught by faculty from IIT Ropar.

title: Natural Language Processing
description: NPTEL course covering NLP fundamentals including text preprocessing, language models, sequence labelling, parsing, sentiment analysis, and machine translation. Taught by faculty from IIT Bombay.

title: Database Management System
description: NPTEL course on DBMS covering relational model, SQL, ER modelling, normalisation, indexing, transaction management, and query optimisation. Taught by faculty from IIT Kharagpur.

title: Data Mining
description: NPTEL course covering data mining concepts including frequent pattern mining, association rules, classification, clustering algorithms, and anomaly detection applied to large datasets.

title: Reinforcement Learning
description: NPTEL course on reinforcement learning covering MDPs, dynamic programming, Monte Carlo methods, temporal difference learning, Q-learning, policy gradient, and deep RL. Taught by faculty from IIT Madras.

title: Introduction to Python Programming
description: Introductory NPTEL course on Python programming covering basic syntax, control flow, functions, data structures (lists, tuples, dictionaries), file handling, and an introduction to object-oriented programming.

title: Linear Algebra (18.06)
description: MIT OCW course by Gilbert Strang covering vector spaces, linear transformations, matrix factorisation (LU, QR, SVD), eigenvalues, positive definite matrices. Includes lecture videos, notes, and problem sets.

title: Introduction to Algorithms (6.006)
description: MIT OCW course covering analysis of algorithms, sorting, hashing, graph algorithms, dynamic programming, and shortest paths. Includes lecture slides, notes, problem sets, and solutions.

title: Introduction to Probability and Statistics (18.650)
description: MIT OCW course on statistics for applications covering parametric inference, MLE, hypothesis testing, regression, and Bayesian statistics. Includes lecture notes and problem sets.

title: Introduction to Computational Thinking and Data Science (6.0002)
description: MIT OCW course covering computational thinking, data analysis, optimisation, simulation, and machine learning using Python. Suitable for students with basic programming background.

title: Machine Learning (6.867)
description: MIT OCW graduate-level machine learning course covering supervised and unsupervised learning, kernel methods, boosting, neural networks, and probabilistic models. Lecture notes available.

title: Introductory Statistics (OpenStax)
description: Free, peer-reviewed introductory statistics textbook from OpenStax covering descriptive statistics, probability, discrete and continuous distributions, hypothesis testing, regression, and ANOVA.

title: Calculus Volume 1 (OpenStax)
description: Free, peer-reviewed calculus textbook (Volume 1) from OpenStax covering functions, limits, derivatives, integration techniques, and applications.

title: Calculus Volume 2 (OpenStax)
description: Free, peer-reviewed calculus textbook (Volume 2) from OpenStax covering integration techniques, sequences and series, and an introduction to multivariable calculus.

title: Data Mining: Concepts and Techniques
description: NPTEL course covering data warehousing, OLAP, frequent itemset mining, association rules, classification trees, clustering algorithms, and outlier detection.

title: Introduction to Computer Networks
description: NPTEL course on computer networks covering OSI and TCP/IP models, application layer protocols (HTTP, DNS, SMTP), transport layer, network layer routing, and link layer. Taught by faculty from IIT Kharagpur.

title: Operating System Fundamentals
description: NPTEL course on operating systems covering process scheduling, memory management, virtual memory, file systems, I/O, and OS security. Taught by faculty from IIT Delhi.

title: Convex Optimisation (EE364A)
duration: Approximately 20 lectures per semester (not stated explicitly)
description: Stanford's EE364A course on convex optimisation. Lecture notes and slides are freely available. Covers convex sets, functions, optimisation problems, duality, and applications. NOTE: Licence for redistribution not verified; direct link to original course provided.

title: Introduction to Big Data
description: NPTEL course on big data analytics covering Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS, MapReduce), Apache Spark, NoSQL databases, and scalable data processing techniques.

title: Ethics in AI (Lecture Notes)
description: MIT OCW resource on fairness in machine learning covering bias metrics, fairness definitions, case studies in development contexts, and ethical frameworks. Lecture notes and materials.

title: Introduction to Computer Vision
description: NPTEL course on computer vision covering image formation, filtering, edge detection, feature extraction, object detection, segmentation, and 3D vision. Taught by faculty from IIT Madras.

title: Statistical Learning Theory
description: NPTEL course on statistical machine learning covering PAC learning, VC dimension, bias-variance tradeoff, regularisation, kernel methods, and concentration inequalities.

title: Discrete Mathematics
description: NPTEL course covering mathematical foundations for computer science: propositional and predicate logic, sets, relations, functions, combinatorics, graph theory, and trees.

title: Data Science: R Basics
duration: 8 weeks (self-paced, approximately 2 hours/week per edX listing)
description: HarvardX course on R programming fundamentals for data science covering data wrangling, visualisation with ggplot2, and basic statistical analysis. NOTE: This course is accessible but free audit may have limited access; redistribution licence not verified.

title: Applied Machine Learning in Python (Coursera / University of Michigan)
description: Coursera course on applied ML in Python using scikit-learn. Covers supervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering, and unsupervised learning. NOTE: Audit available but redistribution licence not verified; audit access may be restricted.

title: Calculus I: Limits and Continuity (MIT OCW - Single Variable Calculus 18.01)
description: MIT OCW single-variable calculus course covering limits, derivatives, integral calculus, applications, and Taylor series. Lecture videos, notes, and problem sets.

title: Linear Algebra by NPTEL (IIT Bombay)
description: NPTEL course on linear algebra covering vector spaces, linear transformations, matrix theory, eigenvalues, orthogonality, and applications in engineering and data science. Taught by faculty from IIT Bombay.

title: Probability and Statistics by NPTEL (IIT Bombay)
description: NPTEL course on probability and statistics covering probability axioms, random variables, distributions, expectation, law of large numbers, hypothesis testing, and regression. Taught by faculty from IIT Bombay.

title: Algorithms: Design and Analysis, Part 1 (Stanford Online)
description: Stanford Online course on algorithm design covering divide and conquer, sorting, master theorem, graph search (BFS, DFS), Dijkstra's algorithm. Audit available. NOTE: Redistribution licence not verified.

title: Introduction to Data Science (SWAYAM)
description: SWAYAM course on introduction to data science covering Python for data analysis, statistical methods, data visualisation, and introductory machine learning techniques.
